Burundi Times describes Burundi's Law No. 1/03 of 10 March 2026 on the protection of personal data as the law the country must now enforce, and says it already regulates international transfers.

The law establishes an Agency for the Protection of Personal Data, but its operational arrangements are still being developed; a draft decree on it was approved subject to adjustments by the Council of Ministers on 18 November 2026 (Burundi Times).

facts.fact: Burundi Times names Baker Birikujja as director of Uganda's Personal Data Protection Office, who chaired the EAC experts' meeting in Moshi on 17-21 November 2026.

Burundi Times says Article 15 of Burundi's data protection law requires countries receiving personal data from Burundi to give an adequate level of protection, and that transfers elsewhere are allowed with appropriate safeguards.
